statement: Warren 2026-10-15 (replaces D-0088): a newer customer sell-through load covering the same customer, product and period supersedes the older stored rows for that customer, product and period, even when the older rows were stored at a different site or day grain (e.g. old chain-level loc=0 rows vs new per-site rows), and whether or not the file is byte-identical. Superseded rows move to fact_customer_sellthrough_superseded with the superseding load recorded; raw staging is kept; nothing is hard-deleted. Same-key restatement stays with the source_key upsert and is not duplicated.
